import re
import sys

def unwrap(content):
    # Pattern for eval("...")
    # We need to handle escaped quotes inside the eval string
    pattern = r'eval\s*\((.*?)\);'

    def replace(match):
        code = match.group(1)
        # Remove surrounding quotes
        if (code.startswith('"') and code.endswith('"')) or (code.startswith("'") and code.endswith("'")):
            code = code[1:-1]
        elif code.startswith('`') and code.endswith('`'):
            code = code[1:-1]

        # Handle escaped quotes
        code = code.replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\r', '\r').replace('\\t', '\t')
        return code

    return re.sub(pattern, replace, content, flags=re.DOTALL)
